abstract: Uterine choriocarcinoma develops fairly frequently after passage of a hydatidiform mole and very rarely after normal pregnancy or abortion. The disease is highly curable by chemotherapy, especially if detected early. Histologic examination of uterine curettings is unreliable and the principal indicator of active primary or metastatic disease is the HCG titer. The ability to visualize the tumor is helpful for a variety of reasons. In the past, this has been achieved primarily through arteriography. Our experience with 6 patients suggests that sonography is as sensitive a detector as arteriography and perhaps somewhat more specific. These facts, plus its convenience and repeatability, make ultrasound the method of choice for visualization of intrauterine malignant trophoblastic disease. Arteriography will continue to play an important role where the sonographic findings are equivocal and where local invasion or distant metastases are suspected.
abstract_ja: 子宮絨毛癌は胞状奇胎の後に比較的頻繁に生じ、正常妊娠や流産後にはごくまれに生じる。この疾患は、特に早期に発見された場合は化学療法により治癒の可能性が高い。子宮内容物の組織学的検査は信頼性が低く、活動性の原発巣または転移巣の主要な指標はヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の値である。腫瘍を描出できることは様々な理由で有用である。従来、これは主に動脈造影により達成されてきた。6例の経験から、超音波検査は動脈造影と同程度に感度の高い検出法であり、おそらくやや特異度も高いと考えられる。これらの事実に加え、簡便性と反復性から、子宮内悪性栄養膜細胞疾患の描出には超音波検査が第一選択の方法である。動脈造影は、超音波所見が不明瞭な場合や、局所浸潤または遠隔転移が疑われる場合に引き続き重要な役割を果たすであろう。
